summary: Frontend-only verification of /products after deleting the 6-card products grid and applying zoom=1.2 to PageShell. All 6 requested checks pass at 1366 and 1920 widths.
critical_code_review_comments: Still using CSS `zoom` (non-standard); combined 1.2 (PageShell) x 1.25 (StepHero) = ~1.5x effective zoom for hero — works in Chromium but Firefox parity remains a concern. Consider `transform: scale()` with proper layout compensation long-term.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On /products: old 6-card grid (Trade/Wallet/Invest/Portfolio/Card/Security) confirmed REMOVED — zero card-title matches in .pf-body. Step hero (data-testid=step-hero), Download Step btn (data-testid=step-download-btn), heading 'Everything you need to trade and invest in crypto', and Get started / Talk to us CTAs all render. pf-body computed zoom = 1.2 at both 1366 and 1920. No horizontal overflow (0px). /products/step standalone still shows the hero. Footer 'Blockscaner Step' link navigates to /products/step correctly.
